products.notes: Dry, free-flowing granular calcium nitrate fertilizer derived from ammonium calcium nitrate double salt. The 50 lb label guarantees 15.5% total N (14.5% nitrate N and 1.0% ammoniacal N) and 19.0% calcium. Yara identifies it as chloride-free and intended for field application. The label provides no universal application rate and directs use according to a qualified recommendation or approved nutrient-management plan. Keep dry and use clean, dry, well-maintained equipment. Do not apply near water, storm drains, drainage ditches, impervious surfaces, or when heavy rain is expected.
